description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_Strategy_MakeWellFormed, which implements a token processing strategy for HTML purification. It processes tokens to ensure well-formed HTML by balancing tags, auto-closing, and handling invalid or stray tags during the purification process.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Strategy_MakeWellFormed
classes.description: A strategy class that ensures tokens form well-structured HTML by balancing tags, autoclosing, and handling errors during the purification process.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main method that processes a list of tokens to make the HTML well-formed, handling tag balancing, autoclosing, and error suppression.

methods.name: processToken
methods.description: Handles token substitution, insertion, or deletion, and manages the token stream via the zipper during processing.

methods.name: insertBefore
methods.description: Inserts a new token before the current position in the token stream.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the current token from the stream.
